title: The Most Beautiful Girl In The World
original_lyrics:
[chorus]
It's plain 2 see U're the reason that God made girl
When the day turns into the last day of all time
I can say, I hope that you are in these arms of mine (oh yeah)
When the night falls before that day I will cry (I cry)
I will cry tears of joy cause after u all one can do is die (oh oh) Coro
How can I get through days when I can't get through hours
I can try but when I do I see u and I'm devoured (Oh yes)
Who' allow, (who' allow) face two be as soft as flower (oh)
I could bow and feel proud in the light of this power Oh oh yeah oh oh
